verdict.rationale: Bolna documents its own post-call extraction: an API creates extraction categories (name plus model) attached to an agent, and the analytics tab configures webhooks, call summaries and extractions to push data to a CRM from every call. The evidence does not show the extracted schema or the webhook payload, so delivery of outcomes, entities and dispositions is only implied. missing for 10: documented extraction schema covering outcomes/entities/dispositions, webhook payload format and timing showing extracted fields, API endpoint for fetching extracted data per call, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
